text: たのむ　から　あっち　いってくれ！

structure.jp: あっち　いってくれ！

patterns.name: 〜てくれ
patterns.explanation: くれ after a て-form is a blunt, male way of telling someone to do something for you. いってくれ = 'go, will you'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement means 'because'; with たのむ it is a set way of pleading. たのむ　から = 'I'm begging you, so'.
